events.verdict: Ighodaro (PHX) is established in a position in Podziemski's (GSW) path and the two players engage and disengage following the screen.
Gillespie (PHX) establishes a position in Green's (GSW) path and does not deliver contact.
Goodwin (PHX) makes contact to the ball and deflects it away from Curry (GSW) during his drive.
The ball is last touched by Goodwin (PHX) before going out of bounds.
Gillespie (PHX) moves alongside Podziemski (GSW) and the contact as Podziemski enters his upward shooting motion is marginal.
Podziemski (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position during Booker's (PHX) drive to the basket.
Podziemski (GSW) legally contests Goodwin's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Goodwin (PHX) is not established in a legal guarding position in Podziemski's (GSW) path, but the ensuing contact is marginal.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the contact by Brooks (PHX) to Curry (GSW) after he follows through meets the criteria for a flagrant foul penalty 1.
Goodwin (PHX) makes contact to Curry's (GSW) wrist, affecting his shot attempt.
Melton (GSW) and Booker (PHX) briefly engage and disengage before he receives the pass.
Green (GSW) legally contests Brooks' (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Ighodaro (PHX) deflects the pass away from Butler III (GSW).

Although Moody (GSW) makes contact to the ball, he also makes more than marginal contact to Goodwin's (PHX) head/neck area and to his arm. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul occurs with 0.4 seconds remaining on the game clock.
